m: अनु-गा f. N. of an Apsaras.
अनु-√ 1. गा to go after, follow; to act in conformity to, or according to the wishes of RV.
अनु-गा (also) to undergo, MBh. iii, 373.
अनु-गाढ mfn. plunged or immersed in.

m: अनु-गादिन् mfn. repeating another's words, Pāṇ. v, 4, 13.
a: अनुगादिन् — a. [गद्-णिनि] Repeating, following in speaking, echoing.

m: अनु-√ गाह् to plunge after, be immersed in.

m: अनु-गामिन् mfn. following, a companion.
a: अनुगामिन् — a. Following. --m. A follower = अनुग.

m: अनु-गामुक mfn. habitually or constantly following or attending.
a: अनुगामुक — a. Habitually or constantly following.

m: अनु-गान n. ‘after-song’, (-शस्), SāmavBr.
अनु-गान-शस् (ind.)
अनु-गापन n. causing to sing after, Gobh.
अनु-गायस् mfn. (√ गै), followed by shouts or hymns, RV. viii, 5, 34
(‘to be praised in hymns’, Sāy.)
अनु-√ गै to sing after or to (a person or tune); to celebrate in song: Caus. -गापयति, to make one sing after or to.
a: अनुगै — {c1c} P. 1 To sing after (a person), sing to (a tune); follow in singing; अनुगायति काचिदुदंचितपंचमरागं Gīt. 1; अनुजगुरथ दिव्यं दुंदुभिध्वानमाशाः Ki. 3. 60 sent back, echoed. --2 To sing; to celebrate in song.

m: अनु-√ 1. गॄ -गृणाति, to join in praising, RV. i, 147, 2, to rejoin, answer, ŚāṅkhŚr.; to repeat, BhP.
अनु-गीता f. ‘an after-song’, N. of part of the fourteenth book of the Mahābhārata (chaps. 16-92).
अनु-गीत (also) mfn. sung after, JaimUp.
अनु-गीत n. an imitative song, Ratnāv.
a: अनुगीतं — Singing in response to; Ratn. 1. 19.

m: अनु-गीति f. N. of a metre (of two verses, the first containing twenty-seven, the second thirty-two mātrās)
a: अनुगीति — See under अनुगै.
अनुगीतिः — f. N. of a metre of two lines, the first having 27 and the second 32, mātrās, a species of the Āryā metre.

m: अनु-ग mf(आ)n. going after, following, corresponding with, adapted to
a companion
a follower, a servant
(ifc.) followed by
a: अनुग — a. [अनुगच्छतीति, गम्-ड] (In comp.) Following, going after; corresponding or tallying with, adequate to; सदा पृष्ठानुगः पुरे Pt. 1. 59; गीतानुगं वारि मृदंगवाद्यं R. 16. 64; Me. 47; कामक्रोधवशानुगं Ms. 2. 214; गोत्ररिक्थानुगः पिंडः 9. 142 governed or regulated by; 8. 239. --गः A follower, (obedient) servant, companion; तद्भूतनाथानुग R. 2. 58, 9. 82; बल˚ followed by an army, being the head of an army.

k.v: नूत्नश्च सुकुमारं तु कोमलं मृदुलम्मृदु। अन्वगन्वक्षमनुगेऽनुपदं क्लीबमव्ययम्.।

m: अनु-गङ्गम् ind. along the Ganges, Pat.
अनु-√ गण् to count over.
अनु-गणित mfn. counted over.
अनु-गणितिन् mfn. one who has counted over, (g. इष्टादि, q.v.)
अनु-गण्डिका f. a chain of hills, MBh.

अनु-√ गम् cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go after, follow, seek, approach, visit, arrive; to practise, observe, obey, imitate; to enter into; to die out, be extinguished: Caus. -गमयति, to imitate cause to die out.
a: अनुगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go after, follow, attend, accompany; अनभिज्ञो गुणानां यो न भृत्यैरनुगम्यते Pt. 1. 73; ओदकांतात्स्निग्धो जनोऽनुगंतव्यः Ś. 4; केकारवैरनुगम्यमानो भूषणनिनादः K. 84; मार्गं मनुष्येश्वरधर्मपत्नी श्रुतेरिवार्थं स्मृतिरन्वगच्छत् R. 2. 2; छायेव तां भूपतिरन्वगच्छत् 6; Ms. 12. 115; Ki. 5. 2. --2 To follow, practise, observe, obey, act up to; प्रतिशब्दक इव राजवचनमनुगच्छति जनो भयात् K. 104; पूर्वैरयमभिप्रेतो गतो मार्गोऽनुगम्यते Rām.; विषत्तौ च महाँल्लोके धीरतामनुगच्छति H. 3. 44. --3 To seek, wander through; काननं वापि शैलं वा यं रामोऽनुगमिष्यति Rām.; कृत्स्नां पृथ्वीमनुगच्छत ibid. go in quest of. --4 To come, arrive, approach, present oneself (as time); काले त्वनुगते Bhāg. --5 To answer or respond to; correspond with, be suitable to; imitate, resemble; धनुःश्रियं गोत्रभिदोऽनुगच्छति Ki. 4. 36; आस्फालितं यत्प्रमदाकराग्रैर्मृदंगधीरध्वनिमन्वगच्छत् R. 16. 13; न चापि कादंबरीं लक्ष्मीरनुगंतुमलं K. 203. --6 To go or die out, be extinguished; यद्येष उख्योऽग्निरनुगच्छेत् Śat. Br. --7 To enter into. --Caus. [--गमयति] To cause to follow, follow; उद्ग्रीवैरनुगमितस्य पुष्करस्य M. 1. 21 followed or accompanied in sound.

s: puM, (anu + gam + BAve ap .) paScAdgamanaM । upasarpaRaM । yaTA, -- “kfte tu dIyate gatvA tretAyAmAhutAya vE । dvApare yAcamAnAya kalO tvanugamAnvite” ॥ iti smftiH ॥ nyAMyamate yena rUpeRa tAvatpadArTagrahaH tadeva rUpaM tAvatpadArTAnugamakaM tasya kriyA ॥

m: अनु-गम, अस्, m. or अनु-गमन, अम्, n. following, going after in life or death post-cremation of a widow imitating, approaching.
a: अनुगमः --मनं — 1 Following; आत्मानुगमनेन गां प्रसादयितुमर्हसि R. 1. 88; बृहतेर्धातोरर्थानुगमात् Ś. B. --2 Comprehending, grasping (as a sense); रसाद्यनुगतः S. D. --3 Following in death, post-cremation, self-immolation of a widow on her husband's funeral pile. --4 Imitating; approaching. --5 Conformity, accordance; श्रुत्यनुगमाच्च Ś. B.

s: klI, (anu sAhityena gamanaM, anu + gam + BAve lyuw .) sahagamanaM । yaTA, “azwO lokapAlA AdityacandrAnilAgnyAkASaBUmijalahfdayAvasTitAntaryAmipuruzayamadinarAtrisanDyADarmmAH ! yUyaM sAkziRo Bavata jvalaccitArohaRena BartfSarIrAnugamanamahaM karomi” । iti SudDitattvaM ॥
v: na॰ anu + gama--BAve lyuw । paScAdgamane । “SavAnugamanASOcaM snAnamAtreRa SuDyatIti” smftiH BarttfSarIrAnugamanamahaM karizyAmIti Su॰ ta॰ raGu॰ ।

m: अनु-गम्य mfn. to be followed or imitated.
अनु-गन्ती f. (for अनु-गन्त्री?) a message, Divyāv.
अनु-गन्तव्य mfn. to be followed (as a husband by a wife in death)
worthy of being imitated, to be looked for or discovered, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 7, Sch.
अनु-गर m. invitation addressed to a reciter, Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 4, 41.
अनु-√ गर्ज् to shout or roar after.
a: अनुगर्ज् — {c1c} P. To roar after or in imitation of.

m: अनु-गर्जित n. roaring after, echo, Kum.
a: अनुगर्जित — p. p. Roared. --तं A roaring echo, Ku. 6. 40.

m: अनुगतार्थ mfn. having a corresponding meaning.

s: tri, (anugacCati anu + gam + karttari ktaH .) anugaH । ASritaH । aDInaH । paScAdgataH । yaTA, -- “AgacCad yatra kAkutsTaH svargAya samupasTitaH । vimAnavarakowIBirdevEranugatastadA” ॥ iti rAmAyaRaM ॥ niyataH । yaTA, “na ca tadanugatameva aBiDAvalambane nApi tasya BAvAt” । iti paYcamollAse kAvyaprakASakAraH ॥

m: अनु-गत mfn. followed by, having anything (as a skin) hanging behind
following
a follower
acquired
extinguished
tallying with
अनु-गत n. moderate time (in music).
a: अनुगत — p. p. 1 (Used passively) (a) Followed (lit. & fig.), attended; अनुगतमलिवृंदैर्गंडभित्तीर्विहाय R. 12. 102; M. 3. 9; Ms. 11. 71. (b) Full of, filled with; दारिद्र्येणाभिभूतेन त्वत्स्नेहानुगतेन च Mk. 4. 5; वर्षधरकलमूकानुगतेन परिजनेन K. 159 consisting or made up of; चिंतानुगतसर्वात्मन् Mb. (c) Covered, as by a dress hanging behind; शिवमिवानुगतं गजचर्मणा Ki. 5. 2 (पश्चाद्व्याप्तं). (d) Extinguished &c. (e) Acquired, obtained. --2 (Used actively) (a) Following, obeying, observing; स्वमतमनुगतः Mu. 5. 19; विभवानुगता भार्या Mk. 3. 28; दिग्विजयप्रसंगेनानुगतो भूमिमिमां K. 191 come to; Ms. 9. 267; K. 166; Mu. 6. 5; H. 2. 56; R. 15. 9. (b) Corresponding or tallying with, adapted or answering to, in harmony with; सूत्रेणानुगतं भवति Ś. B.; पादन्यासो लयमनुगतः M. 2. 9 in accompaniment to the musical time; मृदंग ˚तः संगीतमधुरः Ratn. 1; ˚वीणैः Śi. 11. 10. (c) Adequate or suitable to, fit for; प्रस्तावानुगतं पृष्टः Pt. 5. (d) Imitating; परितुष्टोऽस्मि यत्पितरमनुगतो वत्सः M. 5 I am glad that the boy takes after his father. --तं Moderate time in music. --Comp. --अर्थ a. having a corresponding or easily discoverable sense.

v: strI anu + gama--ktin । anugamane, paScAdgatO, “balasya caturaNgasya nAyakAnugatirnaya” iti “gatAnugatikanyAyaH” ।
m: अनु-गति f. following, imitation, dying out.
a: अनुगतिः — f. 1 Following; बलस्य चतुरंगस्य नायकानुगतिर्नयः Rām.; गतानुगतिक्रो लोकः following, imitating; see under गत. --2 Consent, approval; अकाम˚ forced consent.

m: अनु-गतिक m. a follower, an imitator.

s: puM, (goH paScAt avyayIBAvaH anugu + KaH, tasya InaH .) gopaH । gorakzakaH । goH paScAt yaTezwagAmI । iti saMkziptasAravyAkaraRapariSizwaM ।

m: अनु-गवीन m. a cowherd, Pāṇ. v, 2, 15.
a: अनुगवीनः — [अनुगु गोः पश्चात्पर्याप्तं यथा गच्छति सोऽनुगवीनः गोपालः; अनुगु ख P. V. 2. 15 Sk.] A cowherd.

v: na॰ goHsadfSa AyAmaH “yasya cAyAma” iti samAse ni॰ ac । gavAyAmatulyAyAmayukte SakawAdO ।
a: अनुगव — a. [गोः सदृशः आयामः, अच्] Suiting (the length of) the oxen.

m: अनु-गवम् ind. so as to suit (or follow) the cows, Pāṇ. v, 4, 83.
अनुगेय mfn. to be sung after, Gobh.
अनु-√ गृध् (pr. p. -गृध्यत्) to be greedy after (loc.), MBh. xii, 372.
अनु-गृहीत mfn. favoured, obliged.

a: अनुगिरं — ind. By the mountainside R. 13. 49.

m: अनु-गिरम् ind. on the mountain, Ragh.
अनु-गोदम् ind. near the Godāvarī.
अनु-गोप्तृ m. a protector, defender, R.
अनु-ग्राहक mf(इका)n. favouring, furthering, facilitating
favourable, kind, gracious.
a: अनुग्राहक — a. 1 Favouring, furthering, promoting. --2 Gracious, kind.

m: अनु-ग्राहिन् mfn. gracious, favourable.

v: tri॰ anu + graha--Ryat । anugrahArhe “yadi te'hamanugrAhyo yadi smarasi me guRAniti” “sarvaTAnugrAhyo devatAnAmasaMSaya” iti ca rAmA॰ ।
m: अनु-ग्राह्य mfn. to be favoured or furthered.
a: अनुग्राह्य — pot. p. Fit to be favoured or obliged; ततः कथनेनात्मानमनुग्राह्यमिच्छामि K. 134; न वयमनुग्राह्याः प्रायो देवतानां 61.

m: अनु-ग्रामम् ind. village after village, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 61, into a village, Lāṭy.
अनु-ग्रासक m. a mouthful (of boiled rice, &c.)
the equivalent of a mouthful.
a: अनुग्रासकः — A mouthful; the equivalent of a mouthful.

v: tri॰ na ugraH । SAntasvaBAve asamarTe, anudDate ca । “Bagamanugro aDayAti ratnamiti” f॰ 7, 38, 6, “anugraH asamarTa” iti BA॰ “anugrAsaSca vftrahan f॰ 8, 1, 14, anugrA anudgUrRA iti (BA॰) ukteH anudgUrReca ।
m: अन्-उग्र or अन्-उग्र mf(आ)n. not harsh or violent, mild, gentle, RV. &c.
अनु-√ ग्रह् to follow in taking or plundering, MBh. iv, 996, to support; to uphold; to receive, welcome; to treat with kindness, favour, oblige; to foster.
a: अनुग्रह् — {c9c} P. (Ved. --गृभ्णाति). 1 To favour, oblige, treat with kindness; शिलातलैकदेशमनुगृह्णानु वयस्यः Ś. 3 our friend will be so good as to, or kindly, take a seat on the stone; अयं विष्टरोऽनुगृह्यतां V. 5 be pleased to sit down &c.; महेंद्रेण पुनरनुगृहीता V. 3 favoured (by modifying the curse); with instr. or abl. of that which is an obligation; अनुगृहीतोऽहमनया मघवतः संभावनया Ś. 6; कतरत्कुलमनुगृहीतं भगवत्या जन्मना K. 135; अनुगृहीतोऽस्मि अहमुपदेशाद्भवतः V. 4 I am much obliged to you &c. (अनुगृहीत is oft. used by itself in the sense of ‘much obliged’, ‘many thanks,’ ‘I thank you’, ‘I esteem it a favour’). --2 To foster, cherish, protect, maintain (as fire); अग्निर्नित्यानुगृहीतः स्यात् Āśval. --3 To receive, welcome. --4 To hold up, support, uphold. --5 To follow in robbing, seizing or depriving. --6 To keep to, conform or correspond to, follow, take after; आकृतिमनुगृह्णंति गुणाः Vb. 2; क्षात्रधर्मश्चानुगृहीतो भवति U. 5. --Caus. To cause to favour, or to favour; आर्यस्य दर्शनेनात्मानमनुग्राहयितुं Mu. 4.

m: अनु—˚ग्रहीतृ m. a favourer, furtherer, Śaṃk.

m: अनु-ग्रह m. favour, kindness, showing favour, conferring benefits, promoting or furthering a good object
assistance
facilitating by incantations
rearguard
N. of the eighth or fifth creation, VP.
a: अनुग्रहः, --हणं — 1 A favour, kindness, obligation; showing favour, obliging, rewarding (opp. निग्रह); निग्रहानुग्रहकर्ता Pt. 1; पादार्पणानुग्रहपूतपृष्ठं R. 2. 35; अनुग्रह इवेयमभ्यर्थना Ś. 1; अनुग्रहं संस्मरणप्रवृत्तं Ku. 3. 3. --2 Assistance, help (shown to the poor in feeding them &c. दरिद्रादिपोषणं). --3 Facilitating by spells. --4 Acceptance. --5 Rear-guard. --Comp. --कातर a. anxious to please or for favour. --सर्गः creation of feelings or mental conditions.

m: अनु-ग्रहण n. = अनु-ग्रह.
practising, practice, MBh.
अनु-ग्रह—कातर mfn. anxious to please or for favour.
अनु-ग्रह—सर्ग m. (in Sāṅkhya phil.) creation of the feelings or mental conditions.
अनु-ग्रहिन् m. proficient in magic skill.

m: अनु-गुण mf(आ)n. having similar qualities, congenial to
according or suitable to
अनु-गुण m. natural peculiarity.
a: अनुगुण — a. [अनुकूलो गुणो यस्य] Having similar qualities, of the same nature; कांतारतापसाविक्षू वंशकानुगुणौ स्मृतौ Suśr.; conformable to, favourable or agreeable to, suitable, according to; मनोरथस्यानुगुणं सर्वदा यस्य चेष्टितं Mv. 7. 7 obedient to the will; 7. 38; गुणसंपदानुगुणतां गमितः Ki. 6. 33; 10. 13; congenial, suitable, fit; ˚अन्नलाभात् Dk. 64, 94; अननुगुणदाराणां Dk. 130 not having wives worthy of themselves; (वीणा) उत्कंठितस्य हृदयानुगुणा वयस्या Mk. 3. 3 agreeable or pleasing to the heart, exactly after the heart (Tv. here takes ˚णा to mean तंत्रीयुक्तवीणा itself); अत्र द्वावप्युपध्मानीयावेव न शांतानुगुणौ R. G.; रसानुगुणतामेति S. D.; ˚णं सर्वास्ववस्थासु यत् U. 1. 39 --णः A natural peculiarity. --णं adv. 1 Favourably, conformably to one's desires; चिरेणानुगुणं प्रोक्ता प्रतिपत्तिपराङ्मुखी Bk. 8. 95. --2 Agreeably or conformably to (in comp.); तदादेशानुगुणं भवदागमनमभूत् Dk. 11. --3 Naturally.
